properties.title: Kerch port oil terminal fire
properties.summary: Ukrainian drones struck Kerch port oil/gas terminal, igniting fuel storage tanks. Second attack on this facility.

properties.title: Russian strike on Vyshneve (Kyiv suburb)
properties.summary: Russian missile/drone strike on Vyshneve, Kyiv suburb. 200+ facilities damaged, 7 railway dormitories hit. Mandatory evacuation ordered in parts of Dnipropetrovsk.

properties.title: Omsk refinery strike (2,500 km from front)
properties.summary: Ukraine FP-1 drone strike halted Russia's largest oil refinery, eliminating 8.4M tonnes/year processing unit.

properties.title: Damascus explosions near Macron hotel
properties.summary: Two IEDs detonated near Four Seasons Hotel where Macron was staying. 18 wounded. No group claimed responsibility.

properties.title: Kupyansk direction clashes
properties.summary: Clashes near Novoplatonivka, Kivsharivka. Ukraine general staff reported active combat operations.

properties.title: Explosions in Mariupol: attack on vessels at sea

properties.summary: Drone attack targeted camps of Iranian Kurdish opposition group PJAK near Erbil, Iraqi Kurdistan.
